summary: Caroline County lookout first called the Baylor Lookout; administered by the Virginia Department of Forestry, removed circa 2001-2002, registered 2018. No build or staffing record found.

facts.status_note: Removed circa 2001-2002; no source we read describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

events.note: Register gives the removal as circa 2001-2002
Added to the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on July 30, 2018

evidence.supports: tower was formerly the Baylor Lookout, named after the Baylor family of Bowling Green
evidence.quote: The Caroline Fire Tower was formerly the Baylor Lookout, named after the prominent local family in Bowling Green, the Baylors.

evidence.supports: register title: Caroline Tower Site, formerly Baylor Lookout Site
evidence.quote: Caroline Tower Site (formerly Baylor Lookout Site)

evidence.supports: the Baylor family cemetery is across from where the tower stood
evidence.quote: Their family cemetery is located across from where the tower stood.

evidence.supports: administered by the Virginia Department of Forestry
Forest Lookouts page marks the site as removed

sources.title: Caroline Tower Site (formerly Baylor Lookout Site)

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two sources. The Forest Lookouts page gives only the word Removed for this site, so it adds little beyond the removal. No build date, staffing, fire history or site description was found. Three searches (Baylor, Caroline County, Bowling Green) turned up only general county and town pages, none about this tower. The Bowling Green fire articles that came up concern the town, not the lookout, and were not used. The brief lists the removal as 2002; the register gives circa 2001-2002, so the event year is an approximation.
